title: Recommended trip to Huelva
text:
Exciting visit where they make the best hams. 
A very pleasant and exciting story from the sweetest guide who was very good at explaining the whole process from little pig to finished ham.
author: 320beritf

title: Unexpected favorite
text:
The tasting was generous and genuinely delicious, we tried a few different types and left with a much better appreciation for why the ham here is such a big deal. Pro tip: skip breakfast before this one.

Then came the cave, which honestly caught us off guard. We weren't expecting the visit to Aracena Cave to be as impressive as it was, huge chambers, cool rock formations, little underground lakes. A really nice change of pace from all the eating.
author: butchoi15

title: Great Day Do This Tour
text: Daniel Fernando was a wonderful driver and guide. The caves in Aracena were magical. Very glad we did it. We have been in caves before but this was magical. Our private tour of 5J’s was amazing. Highly recommend Marco was a very good guide. He is a fantastic educator. Highly recommend this tour. The tasting was very good.
author: Mary Jo S

title: Lovely experience, good food and win and great driver
text: Our driver Andreas was extremely friendly polite and caring! The ham was great, wine was great, esp the orange wine
author: Edgar C

title: Iberian Ham Tasting Tour from Seville
text: We had an amazing full-day tour with Daniel! Our guides were fantastic — both were incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and well-organized. Daniel made the entire experience smooth, engaging, and enjoyable. Whether you’re a first-time visitor or returning to the area, I’d highly recommend this tour for a well-paced and memorable day trip. Couldn’t have asked for a better guide or experience!
author: D3385OXelizabethb

title: A must for food lovers!
text: My husband and I spontaneously booked a day trip from Seville for the Iberian Ham Tour. I booked on the 19th and got confirmation the next day. We were picked up by our driver Joan who had texted me his WhatsApp to pass along his number and check in. He was on time and very personable. Joan got us to our destination a bit early (very scenic route), so he took us to a region near a dam for a little bit of sight seeing. Once we got to the tour, we waited a bit to get set up with our guide that spoke English. Our guide was Charlotte who was lovely and spoke pretty clear English. She gave us a lot
author: itsKieu

title: Ham++
text: Oscar is a knowledgeable and wonderful guide who happily shared about Spain and its culture. The ham tasting tour was nothing short of what we expected, especially the blind tasting portion that came with wine. We had ample time for lunch at a bar in Aracena before touring the cave, which is a true hidden gem. Oscar also gave us a few bar recommendations and dropped us off at a convenient location for us to shop for olive oil in Seville. Overall, highly recommend! Thanks Oscar for your generosity!
author: jyolynh

title: Best day trip so far
text:
We did this tour based on a suggestion from Mahsa, its not something that I would have picked normally. I'm so so glad we did it because it was the best day of our trip!

The farm tour and ham tasting was so fun and informative. You also go into the countryside of south Spain to see the farm and cave, so its a bit outside the regular tourist path, which I loved.

title: Great tour
text: We had several tours with this agency and we really loved all of them. They are very professional, punctual and lovely people. Recommend them 100%.

title: One of the best experiences of my life...
text: One of the best experiences of my life! I took my dad when he visited me and Spain and we still talk about it 3 years later. The expert pairing with sherry of each grade of jamon was incredible. Great attention to detail and service.
